bio.text: Sharon Quirk-Silva represents California's 67th Assembly District in North Orange County, including Anaheim, Cerritos, Cypress, Buena Park, Fullerton and La Palma, and is serving her sixth term; she was first elected to the Assembly in 2012.
Before the Legislature she served on the Fullerton City Council from 2004 to 2012, including two terms as Mayor.
She is a lifelong resident of Fullerton and chairs the Assembly Budget Subcommittee No. 5 on State Administration.
